description: This file defines the interface ExternalAssetOwnersReadService, which specifies methods for retrieving transfer and journal entry data related to external asset owners within the Fineract investor module.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersReadService
classes.description: Interface defining read operations for external asset owners, including methods to retrieve transfer data and journal entries.

methods.name: retrieveTransferData
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of ExternalTransferData objects based on optional loan identifiers and limits.

methods.name: retrieveTransferData
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ExternalTransferData entry by transfer ID.

methods.name: retrieveActiveTransferData
methods.description: Retrieves the active transfer data for a specific loan and transfer external ID.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesOfTransfer
methods.description: Fetches journal entries related to a specific transfer, paginated by offset and limit.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesOfOwner
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries for a specified owner external ID, paginated.

methods.name: retrieveFirstTransferByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the first transfer record matching the external transfer ID.

methods.name: retrieveLastTransferIdByExternalId
methods.description: Gets the ID of the last transfer corresponding to an external transfer ID.
